A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in SU(3), the new B- parameters have the same form as B_K at NLO, with the same chiral logarithms but different numerical coefficients.

the SU(3) results are much more complicated than the SU(2) results, and that the continuum partially quenched chiral perturbation results are simpler than the corresponding staggered chiral results, and in some cases identical to them.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the new physics models considered in this work, the new physics contributions are not suppressed in the chiral limit, but rather are enhanced.
the chiral behavior of new operators is very different from the chiral behavior for the Standard Model operators.
the chiral logarithm for the Standard Model operator is not universal, and in general, the chiral logaritms for new physics B-parameters can be different.
